_comment: Companies that stay in the seed list (so their roles keep surfacing in digests) but must NEVER be auto-applied to. The /job-apply command checks company_name against this list and skips the apply loop for any match. Matching is case-insensitive on `name`, which must equal the company_name as it appears in the digest / jobs.db.

companies.name: Klaviyo
companies.reason: Inside contact at Klaviyo — funnel new opportunities through them, not the auto-apply agent.
